### L1 review (#34770, part 1 of 3) · 2026-11-18T01:53Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: 5ed57cc3bb57f242a13f808fd72c6dde4ee33fc8

`check-governed-merges --branch` at this head reads tier H. Six paths are under `skills/**`, and the 600 changed lines are under the 3000-line threshold. The low-risk skills arm reads NOT MEASURED, and it cannot apply here because `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is in the diff. Landing goes to the seat's at-tier review and then to the governed approver. This verdict does not ready the PR, and it carries one landing condition, stated below.

#### Must-fix
None.

#### Should-fix
- **S1. First check 3 says a running environment "serves the same contract as JSON Schema: `GET /api/v1/meta/types`, `entries[].schema`." That is new text in a published skill, and "the same" is not accurate.**
  - The route exists, and it does serve `entries[].schema` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-discovery-and-bases.ts:638-766`).
  - But it serves the zod OUTPUT derivation, not the authoring one. `packages/metadata-protocol/src/erased-authoring-mark.ts:16-34` says so, and records the authoring derivation as measured and refused for the served surface: 24 of 26 types answer differently, and the `required` entries number 1132 against 867.
  - An agent that authors from the served document reads every defaulted key as required. It also sees a bare-string predicate arm as `{}`, an annotated husk.
  - Fix it in the same sentence. Say the served schema is the parsed (output) shape, and that the Zod source decides what to write. Or drop the clause.
  - `SKILL.md` sits at +0 headroom, so pay the words in the same file or move the row by the measured remainder.

#### Landing condition (seat)
- **The cloud's exact-heading reads (the dev's open question 1; the PR body's acceptance note 1).**
  - #34691 records that the cloud serves sections of the ui, data and automation skills by exact heading, and that a renamed heading throws at cloud module load.
  - Eleven headings leave `SKILL.md` in this PR. The dev could not read the cloud repository, and no gate here pins those headings.
  - Nothing in the diff can settle this. Before this PR and a skills release reach the cloud together, someone with cloud access has to check the list against the cloud's reads.
  - I am raising it as a landing condition, not as a finding against the PR.

#### What I checked
- **Shape and scope.**
  - `Part-of #34770` is present, with no closing keyword, which is right for part 1 of 3.
  - Clause-② `no` and Metadata-protocol `none` match claim 6964857600.
  - All eight files are on the claim's surface: `SKILL.md`, `rules/**`, the six moved files' ratchet rows, and a root changeset. No eval file is touched.
  - Both merges of `origin/main` are pure: `git show --remerge-diff` is empty for `dcd4b729` and `5ed57cc3`.
- **No teaching lost.** I read `SKILL.md` on main (`1282a464e9`) against the head and followed every section to its new home.
  - Form Views, the long-form paragraph, Master-Detail Forms (three options plus the line-item grid) and Field Conditional Rules in Forms are byte-for-byte in `rules/list-views.md`. The relative links were rewritten correctly for one level deeper: `./actions.md` and `../../objectstack-data/SKILL.md#conditional-field-rules`.
  - The App intro, the one-App-per-package paragraph, the `requiresObject` callout and the `AppContextSelector` bullet are verbatim in `rules/navigation.md`. The keys-by-type sentence carries every Properties cell of the old table.
  - The action intro and the placement and write detail are in `rules/actions.md`. That includes `action-no-placement` and `action-record-write-discarded`, and why `js` and why `api.write`.
  - The `layout` auto-flow clause is in `rules/dashboards.md`.
  - The public-form row is in § Form Views.
  - "Hiding an app is not gating it" in the new lead is taught at `rules/navigation.md:74-82`.
  - What was dropped is declared in the disposition table: the Read-side pointer, the list-kind when-to-use column, and the verify symptom detail. Each has a home.
  - The trap texts are the old sentences, shortened. I found no new rule in them.
- **Links.**
  - I grepped the tree at the head for links to the eleven removed anchors. The only hit is the changeset's own note. `rules/pages.md`'s Date Macros link is re-pointed to objectstack-query `rules/filters.md`, which owns the vocabulary, as the old Date Macros section itself said.
  - The dev's `check:doc-anchors` line reads that 1050 fragments resolve.
  - The bound headings `### Navigation Item Types`, `### Action Types` and `## Report Types` keep their exact text.
- **Ratchet.**
  - `SKILL.md` drops 3921 → 2241 and `pages.md` drops 5669 → 5661.
  - Four rows are raised by exactly their receiving files' measured bytes: list-views +1081, navigation +368, actions +208, dashboards +17. Each is pinned at +0.
  - The six files net −18 bytes.
  - The raises rest on the header's clause that "a ruling of record that orders text into a file still authorises its own measured delta". The body quotes decision record 6943107981 S3 = A and the 2026-10-27 ruling (record 6513306068). The script cannot read rulings, so the seat's contract review checks the quote.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/skills` patch, the only published package that moves. That is the right level for Metadata-protocol `none`.
- **Evals.**
  - The before and after rounds held the runner, cases and model constant: 26/32 with the skill and 4/32 without, in both rounds. One case flipped each way, and #8's failure is the literal-substring grading of a "don't write `${record.name}`" sentence.
  - The 112-token deterministic check on the post-#35022 case set shows 0 tokens lost.
  - The NOT MEASURED second pair is declared with its reason. The card's done-when, "eval cases pass at least as often", holds on the measured pair.
- **CI on this head, read at review time.** Nothing is red.
  - Concluded green: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Build Core, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test Core (3/10), Lint · ESLint, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, and Type Check · workspace, source gates and debt ledger.
  - Still running: Test Core 1 and 2, Type Check · consumer gates, and the Lint repo, docs, CI, PM and two scoped families.
  - Landing waits for these to go green.

#### Notes (nit-level)
- **N1.** `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md:281` points in prose at "objectstack-ui → Master-Detail Forms". That heading now lives in `rules/list-views.md`, not in `SKILL.md`. It is still reachable through trap 3's link and the Form Views routing row. Part 3, the data skill, can make it a link. That file is off this part's surface.
- **N2.** The catalog total is flat (−18 bytes), as the body says. The card's "catalog falls toward 0.5 MB" is not advanced by this part, and the body does not claim it is.

Cloud reading for this PR, requested by repo:objectstack#3 (01:51Z) · 2026-11-18T01:54Z

Read from cloud `main` `aa67666f9`. The cloud's list of exact-heading reads is `packages/service-ai-studio/src/skills/published-refs.ts`, resolved by `readPublishedSection` in `packages/service-ai-studio/src/skills/published-skills.ts`. A heading must occur **exactly once** in the named file, or the read throws at module load.

**What the cloud reads from `objectstack-ui`, all of it:**

| Ref | File | Heading |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `PUBLISHED_LIST_VIEWS` | `SKILL.md` | `List Views` |
| `PUBLISHED_ACTIONS` | `SKILL.md` | `Actions` |
| (board / calendar / gallery / gantt ref) | `rules/list-views.md` | `Adding a board, calendar, gallery or gantt beside the list` |

**Against this PR's moved headings:** two are read by the cloud, `### List Views` and `## Actions`, both from `SKILL.md`. None of the others is read: `View Types`, `Form Views`, `Master-Detail Forms …`, `Field Conditional Rules in Forms`, `Detailed Rules`, `Navigation Item Types`, `CRM UI Blueprint …`, `Date Macros …`, `Action Types`, `Common Pitfalls`, `Verify your work` and `References`.

**So:** if `List Views` or `Actions` leave `SKILL.md` (or stop being unique there), the cloud's `readPublishedSection` throws once it consumes skills from this tree. In dev that is at once: cloud links `@objectstack/skills` as `link:../../../objectstack/packages/skills`. For the hosted build, it is at the next skills bump. The two clean routes:
1. Keep `### List Views` and `## Actions` in `SKILL.md` in this PR (router-size permitting), and move the rest.
2. Or move them, with a paired cloud change to `published-refs.ts` (the new `file:` for both refs) landing in the same window as the cloud's skills bump. That needs a cloud card first.

The other data and automation refs in that file are untouched by this PR.

2026-11-18T01:58Z **Cloud reading at this head (`5ed57cc3b`), refining triage#1's comment above. Only one of the cloud's reads breaks.**

| Cloud ref (`published-refs.ts`) | File · heading | At `5ed57cc3b` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PUBLISHED_ACTIONS` | `SKILL.md` · `Actions` | **still there**, once (`## Actions`, line 132) |
| `PUBLISHED_ADD_A_VIEW` | `rules/list-views.md` · `Adding a board, calendar, gallery or gantt beside the list` | still there, once |
| `PUBLISHED_LIST_VIEWS` | `SKILL.md` · `List Views` | **gone**: 0 matches in `SKILL.md`, none in `rules/` either |

The teaching that `PUBLISHED_LIST_VIEWS` served ("Keep the kind the request names") now lives in `SKILL.md` as item 1 of `## Traps — each parses, then fails at run time`. The cloud's `PublishedRef` already takes an `item` (it reads `rules/naming.md` · `Critical Rules` · item 6 that way). So route 2 is a one-line cloud change: re-point `PUBLISHED_LIST_VIEWS` to `{ file: 'SKILL.md', heading: 'Traps — each parses, then fails at run time', item: 1 }`. That change must land before or with the cloud's next skills pin bump.

If this PR keeps the move, please mail repo:cloud#1 (objectstack#34158) when it merges. The cloud lane will file and land that change ahead of its next pin round. The Traps heading would then become a cloud read, so a later rename of it needs the same check.

### L1 delta review (#34770, part 1 of 3), round 2 · 2026-11-18T02:10Z

L1: ACCEPT
Head-sha: 32fa1759a026a54e473e754d47d36c5ca227151e

This is a delta from my ACCEPT 6966617018 at `5ed57cc3bb`, and it supersedes that verdict for this head. My S1 is closed. The landing condition I raised is met in this tree by route 1 of the cloud reading 6966635524. Tier H is unchanged. This verdict does not ready the PR.

#### Must-fix
None.

#### Should-fix
None.

#### What I checked
- **The delta.** `5ed57cc3bb..32fa1759a0` is one commit, `32fa1759`. It touches seven files, the same set as before minus `pages.md`, all on the claim's surface.
- **S1 is closed.** First check 3 now says the Zod source "decides what to write". It says the route serves "the parsed shape as JSON Schema … a defaulted key reads as required and a bare-string predicate as `{}`". That matches `erased-authoring-mark.ts:16-34` and the output-derivation refusal recorded there.
- **The cloud's heading reads.** I checked the head against the list in 6966635524 and the refinement in 6966703093. The cloud's resolver throws unless a heading occurs exactly once in the named file.
  - `SKILL.md` has `### List Views` once, under a restored `## View Types`. The section holds the nine kinds and the keep-the-kind rule.
  - `SKILL.md` has `## Actions` once. The write-button rule now leads it, ahead of `### Action Types`.
  - `rules/list-views.md` has `## Adding a board, calendar, gallery or gantt beside the list` once.
  - So the cloud needs no paired change for this PR. The nine-kinds sentence left `rules/list-views.md` to make room, so it is not duplicated.
- **Text that left in this round, and where it went.**
  - First check 4's two examples moved. The bare field ref in a predicate is now in `rules/actions.md` § Visibility, on the `visible` bullet. The widget binding that resolves to nothing, giving an empty chart, is now in `rules/dashboards.md` § Dataset-bound widgets.
  - Three nav-table glosses moved. The `componentRef` format is now in `rules/navigation.md`'s keys sentence. "No `reportName` = the report index" was already at `rules/navigation.md:56`. "`doc` inherits the docs audience" was already at `rules/pages.md:358`.
  - The router's lead line and the table's lead sentence were dropped. The table header now reads "Open first".
  - The traps are now five plus a pointer line, `Two more: [List Views](#list-views), [Actions](#actions)`. Both anchors resolve to the unique headings above.
- **Ratchet.** I ran `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` from a worktree at this head. It exits 0, with 58 authored files within their ceilings.
  - Every ui row sits at +0: `SKILL.md` 2240, `actions.md` 3032, `dashboards.md` 6274, `list-views.md` 4448, `navigation.md` 2564, `pages.md` 5661.
  - Against main, `SKILL.md` and `pages.md` go down, and the four receiving rows rise by their files' measured bytes, under the same authority as round 1.
  - `list-views.md` went down from round 1 (4532 → 4448).
  - The row comments were rewritten, and the `SKILL.md` row names the two cloud-served sections.
- **Changeset.** It is updated to the new shape. It is still `@objectstack/skills` patch, and its old-anchors sentence now lists `#form-views` in place of `#view-types`, which is correct because `## View Types` is back.
- **CI on this head, read at review time.** Nothing is red.
  - Concluded green: PR-body guards, Check Changeset (first run), Check PR Size, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Build Core, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Dogfood Regression Gate, TypeScript Type Check, all four Type Check jobs, Lint · ESLint, Lint · repo & tooling, Lint · docs & code guards, and the three scoped Lint jobs.
  - Still running: Test Core 1-3, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · CI, release & engine gates, and a second Check Changeset run.
  - Landing waits for these to go green.

#### Notes
- **N1** (carried, nit): the `objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md:281` prose pointer belongs to part 3. **N2** (carried): the catalog total is flat.
- **N3.** The eval pair was measured on round 1's tree. This round moves the keep-the-kind and write-button text back into headed `SKILL.md` sections and trims two first-check examples into rules files. Whether to re-run the pair is the seat's call. Those texts were inline on main and in both measured rounds, so I see no case that loses its route.
- **N4.** The cloud reading 6966703093 asks to be mailed if the List Views move had landed. Under route 1 the cloud's three reads still resolve, so there is nothing for repo:cloud#1 to re-point. Any later rename of `### List Views` or `## Actions` in this file needs the same check.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `32fa1759a026a54e473e754d47d36c5ca227151e`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs
Security-touching: yes

Read: card #34770 (body, five comments), PR #35077 (body, eight files, the net diff against merge base `1282a464e9`), the check-runs on the head, and the two ruling comments the ratchet rows cite (6943107981 on #34691, 6513306068 on #27847). Nothing was checked out, built or re-run; file sizes and headings were read with `git cat-file` / `git show`, and the eval tokens were compared as literal substrings of the two trees' text.

`Security-touching: yes` is meant. The changed hunks teach permission and sharing behaviour, all of it moved or condensed text: `tabPermissions` hides an app and does not gate it, `requiredPermissions`-gated groups, a filter token is presentation scope and RLS decides what is read, the anonymous public form (`sharing: { enabled, allowAnonymous, publicLink }`, now in `rules/list-views.md`), and `capabilities: ['api.write']`. No security rule changes meaning. The low-risk arm cannot apply in any case: the ratchet script is in the diff.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Headings and anchors of a published file.** Nine headings leave `SKILL.md`: `### Form Views`, `### Master-Detail Forms (parent + child line items)`, `### Field Conditional Rules in Forms`, `## Detailed Rules`, `## CRM UI Blueprint (Metadata-First)`, `## Date Macros — Filter Placeholders`, `## Common Pitfalls`, `## Verify your work`, `## References`. Three are new: `## First checks`, `## Traps — each parses, then fails at run time`, `## Where to go`. Seven stay with their exact text and level: `## View Types`, `### List Views`, `## App Navigation`, `### Navigation Item Types`, `## Actions`, `### Action Types`, `## Report Types`. Right: no file under `skills/**` at the head links a removed `SKILL.md` anchor, and the one that did (`rules/pages.md`) is re-pointed to the vocabulary's owner.
- **Cloud coupling (landing condition): holds in the tree.** Each of the three headings the cloud reads occurs exactly once in its file, with content of its own:
  - `SKILL.md` line 92, `### List Views`: the nine kinds and the keep-the-kind rule, up to `## App Navigation`.
  - `SKILL.md` line 130, `## Actions`: the write-button rule, then `### Action Types` with its table and the `target` sentence.
  - `rules/list-views.md` line 285, `### Adding a board, calendar, gallery or gantt beside the list`: unchanged from main. The level is `###`; the L1 delta comment writes it `##`, which is a slip in that comment, not in the tree.
  - None of the nine departed headings is in the cloud reading (6966635524, refined by 6966703093). The reading itself is triage's and the cloud lane's; this record did not read the cloud repository.
- **Liveness bindings.** `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` is not in the diff and still names `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` with `## Report Types`, `### Action Types`, `### Navigation Item Types`. Each heading is unique at the head, and the tables keep every member: six action types, four report types, ten navigation variants. Right.
- **Frontmatter.** Lines 1–26 are byte-identical to main, `description` included, so skill triggering is untouched. Right.
- **Ratchet accept-set.** Six existing rows change, no row is added, no file is added. Two fall (`SKILL.md` 3921 → 2240, `pages.md` 5669 → 5661). Four rise (`list-views.md` 3451 → 4448, `navigation.md` 2184 → 2564, `actions.md` 2808 → 3032, `dashboards.md` 6232 → 6274). Every number equals the head's measured bytes under the script's convention. The authority for the four raises is the open point in ③.
- **Check-runs on the head.** 29 success, 18 skipped, none red, one still running at read time: `Test Core (1/10)`. Green among them: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Build Core, all four Type Check jobs. Landing waits for the last shard.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/34770-skill-router-ui.md` bumps `@objectstack/skills` by `patch`. Right: the only published package that moves is the skills bundle, and the change is documentation moved between its files.

Clause-②: no — matches the PR body, the changeset and the claim (6964857600); `Metadata-protocol: none` likewise. No authorable key, enum member or served shape changes.

N3 (nit) — the changeset's last sentence says a reader of `#common-pitfalls` finds it in "the traps and first check 4". The two pitfalls went to `rules/list-views.md` (Column Features) and `rules/dashboards.md`, not to the traps.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Round 1, Q1 (cloud heading reads): answered, route 1.** Verified in the tree, see ①.
- **Round 1, Q2 (the three enumeration tables): answered, stay inline.** The tree agrees.
- **Round 1, Q3 (forms): answered, taught in `rules/list-views.md`.** No `rules/forms.md` at the head and no new ratchet row.
- **Round 1, Q4 and round 2's question (eval pair on the final head): answered by the seat, result outstanding.** The measured pair (26/32 before and after) is of round 1's tree; round 2's tree is not measured on the runner. The seat has a fresh pair running on this head. This record does not cover its result, and the card's done-when is read off it.
- **Deviation, "three receiving ratchet rows rose again": ESCALATED to the Tier H approver.** The four raises have no order of record that names their files.
  - Ruling 6943107981, S3 = A, reads verbatim: "One copy of the shape knowledge, two thin procedures. Targets: intent-led descriptions, a router-sized `SKILL.md` (6–9 KB, at most 500 lines), a JSON form beside the TypeScript, pointers to the contract instead of restated lists". It orders the entry file down. It names no `rules/` file, and for restated lists it orders a pointer, not a move.
  - Ruling record 6513306068 opens the standing path to "a PR whose diff shows deletion of restatement in the same file". None of the four receiving files shows a deletion against main; their diffs are additions.
  - So the raises rest on an inference: a router cannot be reached without the text going somewhere, and the card forbids dropping a trap. The inference is reasonable, and the ratchet's purpose holds: the seven hand-authored ui files net −141 bytes, authored tokens −34, the sum of ceilings −46. Earlier rows in the script were raised on rulings that order text "into the published skills" as a class, which is the same looseness.
  - The script says the quote is checked here. The quote is accurate; the order it is cited for is not in its words. The approver's merge should cover that knowingly.
- **Out-of-scope note, no gate pins the cloud's three headings.** True in the tree: the pin is this PR's one-time hand check. A later rename of `### List Views` or `## Actions` breaks the cloud at module load with nothing red here. Worth a follow-up card; not this PR's to carry.
- **Deviation, `rules/forms.md` created and removed:** not in the net diff.
- **SQL push-down:** not applicable, the diff holds no query code.

### ④ Design judgment

S1 (should-fix) — `rules/navigation.md` line 43 teaches that a separator takes `label` and `icon`; the schema refuses both.
- The new sentence reads "Keys by item type (the ten types; each takes `label`, `icon`)". The tenth type is `separator`.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` declares the separator as a strict object of `type`, `id` and `order` (line 842), and files `label` and `icon` among the keys it rejects by name (line 160: "a separator is a divider and declares only `id` and `order`").
- Main's table gave the separator row "—" in its Properties column, so this is an alteration made in the move, not a carried error.
- The harm is small, since the parse refuses it with guidance. But it is a restated key list that drifted from the contract in the act of restating, which is the card's own "Why".
- Fix on the prose face, in that sentence: "each but `separator` takes `label`, `icon`". The row sits at +0, so pay the bytes in the same file, or replace the keys sentence with a pointer to `ui/app.zod.ts`, which is what S3 orders for a restated list and lowers the row.

No must-fix.

**`skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` — holds, apart from the nits below.**
- Against the card's scope: four first checks, five listed traps plus two under served headings, one routing table, three bound enumerations. 8,978 bytes and 164 lines, inside the 6–9 KB band and the 500-line cap.
- Against the card's eval evidence (`analytics-inline-vs-dataset#5`, the skill invoked and its reference never opened): trap 3 orders `rules/dashboards.md` read before any widget, and the routing table names `references/react-blocks.md`.
- First check 3 agrees with `packages/metadata-protocol/src/erased-authoring-mark.ts` lines 16–34: the route serves the output derivation, and the input derivation was measured and refused. The L1 S1 is closed in the tree.
- "Hiding an app (`tabPermissions`) is not gating it: its URL still opens" agrees with `rules/navigation.md` § Who sees or opens an app.
- "Every type but `script` requires `target`" agrees with `action.zod.ts` lines 674–696.
- The added clause "'Add a board' is a NEW `listViews` entry, never `list` retyped" agrees with the section it links.
- Trap 5 agrees with `rules/record-page.md` §5–6.
- Eval tokens: 112 `must_contain` tokens over the four case files at the head; 0 are in main's ui text and absent from the head's; 9 are in neither.

**`rules/list-views.md` — holds.** Form Views, Master-Detail Forms and Field Conditional Rules are main's text byte for byte, with the two relative links rewritten for the deeper directory, and both targets exist. The public-form sentence carries the blueprint row. The new lead pointer to Record Presentation lands on a section that teaches width, column count and the `sections` ladder. The board heading is untouched.

**`rules/navigation.md` — holds except S1.** The `App.create` sentence, the one-App paragraph, the `requiresObject` callout and the `AppContextSelector` note are main's text.

**`rules/actions.md` — holds.** The intro and the placement / write paragraph carry everything the entry section dropped: `rowActions` / `bulkActions`, both lint codes, why `js`, why `api.write`. Both codes exist in `packages/lint` and report as warnings.

**`rules/dashboards.md` — holds.** Both received clauses agree with main's Common Pitfalls 2 and Verify section.

**`rules/pages.md` — holds.** The pointer names `objectstack-query` `rules/filters.md`, which states the unknown-token refusal and the runtime throw.

**`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (implementing file) — the numbers agree, sentence by sentence.**
- `SKILL.md`: 15,704 → 8,978 bytes, 8,958 priced, ceil(8958 / 4) = 2240.
- `actions.md`: 12,126 bytes, 3032, ceiling +224.
- `dashboards.md`: 25,094 bytes, 6274, ceiling +42.
- `list-views.md`: 17,790 bytes, 4448; 7 tokens of headroom absorbed, ceiling +997.
- `navigation.md`: 10,256 bytes, 2564; 2 tokens of headroom absorbed, ceiling +380.
- `pages.md`: 22,644 bytes, 5661.
- "100990 → 100849" for the seven files: both sums check.
- Each comment's account of what moved matches the diff. The authority sentence is the point escalated in ③.

N1 (nit) — first check 4 says "The traps below pass it", and the section heading says each "parses".
